content: भृङ्गः [भृ-गन् कित् नुट् च <ls>Uṇ. 1. 122.</ls>] .²1 A large black bee; मञ्जु गुञ्जन्तु भृङ्गाः <ls>Bv. 1. 5</ls>; <ls>R. 8. 53</ls>. .²2 A kind of wasp. .²3 A kind of bird. .²4 A libertine, dissolute or lecherous man; <ab>cf.</ab> भ्रमर. .²5 A golden vase or jar. .²6 The fork-tailed shrike. .²7 A kind of measure (in music). .{@-ङ्गम्@} Talc. .{@-ङ्गी@} .²1 The female of the large black bee; भृङ्गीव पुष्पं पुरुषं स्त्री वाञ्छति नवं नवम्. .²2 A poisonous plant (अतिविष).
